# How to use
- Install the latest version of [MelonLoader](https://melonwiki.xyz/#/?id=automated-installation)
- place ``NovaLandsArchipelago.dll`` and ``Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dl`` in the Mods folder
- upon launching Nova Lands there might be a few errors in the MelonLoader console, you can ignore those
- connect to a slot via the box on the left of the screen
# What's randomized?
- Research and boss defeats are locations
- research is received as an item (it has to be researched again to get the effect. if you don't have the item it won't take ressources and only send the check)
# Goal options
- Each of the three bosses
- Museum Completion (untested)
